title: Phishing & Credential Harvesting
tip: Scammers send deceptive emails pretending to be academic or financial authorities to steal login credentials and passwords.

title: Digital Footprint & Location Tracking
tip: Unsecured apps and malicious websites track user locations, search histories, and browsing habits without explicit consent.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA/2FA)
tip: Always enforce two-step verification across all student and financial portals to prevent unauthorized access even if passwords leak.

title: Public Wi-Fi Security Vulnerabilities
tip: Using open public Wi-Fi networks in cafes or stations without a VPN exposes traffic to packet sniffing and man-in-the-middle attacks.

title: Social Media Oversharing & PII Leaks
tip: Publishing personal details like phone numbers, schedules, or home addresses on public profiles invites identity theft.

title: Ransomware & Malware Prevention
tip: Never download attachments or cracked software from unverified sources to protect your system from file encryption malware.

title: Secure Cloud Storage Practices
tip: Encrypt sensitive academic documents before uploading them to cloud drives and restrict folder sharing permissions.

title: Identity Theft (2024-2026 Trends)
tip: Advanced AI deepfakes and spoofed identity documents are increasingly used by fraudsters to bypass digital KYC checks.

title: Browser Cookie & Tracker Management
tip: Regularly clear browser cache and block third-party tracking cookies to stop aggressive online behavioral profiling.

title: Mobile App Permissions Audit
tip: Periodically review smartphone settings to revoke unnecessary microphone, camera, and contact access given to mobile apps.

title: Cyber Fraud Reporting Protocol
tip: Immediately report financial cyber frauds via the national helpline 1930 or official portal cybercrime.gov.in.

title: Secure E-Commerce & Payment Gateways
tip: Verify HTTPS status and use virtual credit cards or secure UPI pins while executing online transactions.

title: Field Study Pre & Post Assessments
tip: Conducting structured questionnaires before and after training sessions to accurately measure student awareness progress.

title: Password Hygiene & Vault Management
tip: Avoid reusing passwords across multiple platforms; use reputable password managers to generate complex credentials.

title: AI-Driven Social Engineering Awareness
tip: Recognize voice cloning and AI-crafted phishing messages designed specifically to deceive college students.
